generation.scope: For every prescribed projective trace normal N and line ell, including every nilpotent/Jordan type and repeated or tangent factor, there is a nineteen-dimensional irreducible marked chart whose geometric generic window is finite, opposite rank ten, quadratic Koszul and left/right AS regular, and whose mixed discriminant is ell times v-transpose N v. Its indexed-class image has dimension nine minus the projective orthogonal stabilizer dimension of the pair; varying the pair gives dimension twelve. The proof uses an etale commutator inverse, three exact exceptional finite mixed windows, and all internal degrees of the relative bar complex.

Compare the finite mixed branch via its four-dimensional Frobenius algebra and lifts of normal quadrics. Continue the finite graph structure for supports below seventeen.
